subject: Run DESIGN.md discovery now and judge its durable loop placement

instruction.immediate: Do not wait for governance discussion to begin learning. Treat DESIGN.md/design-system discovery as an available research direction and run it when informative.
instruction.provisional_placement: Storybook research/reference channel under the broader visual-learning system.
instruction.autonomy: Doré has authority to judge whether this research direction belongs in Storybook or another existing loop, or whether architecture should change.
instruction.current_governance: If Doré proposes placement anywhere other than Storybook research, first report the proposed placement and the evidence/reasoning. Architecture changes require three-party agreement: user + ChatGPT + Doré.
instruction.fast_path: If Doré independently concludes that DESIGN.md discovery belongs in Storybook research, no additional report/discussion/approval is required for that placement. Adopt it and continue running.
instruction.scope: This rule applies to placement of this DESIGN.md research direction. Doré may continue ordinary within-loop research, learning, experimentation and evidence work autonomously.

research_channel.name: DESIGN.md / AI-readable design-system discovery
research_channel.role: one source channel among real websites, editorial references, typography, motion, interaction, design systems and other visual sources
research_channel.purpose: discover searchable design knowledge, extraction methods, schemas and visual references that can become experiments and durable learning
research_channel.not_a_goal: do not create a permanent standalone loop merely because DESIGN.md resources exist

decision_requirements_if_not_storybook: name the existing loop or new architecture location proposed
explain why Storybook research is structurally insufficient
show expected information-flow and ownership boundaries
state migration impact on existing goals and evidence
wait for user + ChatGPT + Doré agreement before durable architecture change

acceptance.storybook_fast_path: If Storybook research is judged correct, persist that placement and immediately continue research without opening governance discussion.
acceptance.alternative_path: If another placement is judged superior, publish a bounded architecture proposal and continue only non-destructive research while awaiting three-party agreement.
acceptance.learning_pass: Research still requires reusable knowledge/experiment evidence; URL collection alone is not learning PASS.
